visits.noneOwner: When buyers or tenants book a site visit on your listings, it shows up here to confirm.
visits.noneSeeker: Book a site visit from any property and track it here.
visits.reconfirmOwner: The visit returns to “Awaiting confirmation” so the owner can re-confirm the new time.
visits.reconfirmVisitor: The visit returns to “Awaiting confirmation” so the visitor can re-confirm the new time.
visits.emptyOwner: Site-visit requests on your listings will appear here so you can confirm, reschedule or cancel them.
visits.emptySeeker: Book a site visit from any property to line up a viewing — you can track and manage it here.
visits.calendarSub: Every scheduled, confirmed and past visit at a glance
visits.clickDay: Click a day to see the weekly schedule
visits.waConfirmed: Hi {{name}}, your visit to {{listing}} is confirmed {{when}}. See you then! — Draazy
visits.waCancelled: Hi {{name}}, unfortunately the visit to {{listing}} {{when}} has been cancelled. Happy to help you reschedule. — Draazy
visits.waPending: Hi {{name}}, regarding your visit request for {{listing}} {{when}}. Let me know if the slot works and I’ll confirm it. — Draazy
visits.waReschedOwner: Hi {{name}}, can we move your visit to {{listing}} to {{date}} at {{time}}? Please confirm and I’ll lock it in. — Draazy

fin.healthTipBody: A single money-at-risk signal for the selected property and period. Red — a payment is overdue. Amber — a payment is due soon or cashflow is negative. Green (Healthy) — nothing is due and cashflow is positive.

fin.noTxSub: Add rent received or an expense to start your ledger.

wallet.title: Rent Wallet
wallet.intro: Every rupee of rent, working for you — record the home you rent and see your yearly total, your deposit and the tax your rent is saving you.
wallet.emptyBody: Rent does not move through Draazy, so tell us what you already pay and your <1>Rent Wallet</1> fills in — yearly totals, a deposit tracker and your HRA tax saving.
wallet.hraNote: Pune is a non-metro (40% of basic). Claim it in your ITR — ask your landlord for signed receipts adding up to the yearly total above.
wallet.addSalaryPrompt: Add your annual basic salary to see how much tax your rent is saving you.
wallet.depositSub: Your biggest locked-up amount — tracked to refund.
wallet.depositForegone: In a liquid fund this deposit could earn about <1>{{amount}}/yr</1>. We’ll help you get it back in full at move-out.
wallet.noDeposit: No deposit on record for this rental.
wallet.emiTitle: Your rent could be an EMI
wallet.emiBody: At {{rent}}/mo, you could service the EMI on a home worth about <1>{{price}}</1>. See if buying beats renting for you.
wallet.selfDeclared: You entered this. Draazy does not collect this rent and has not verified it.
wallet.formSub: Only the address, the rent and the start date are needed.
wallet.formAddress: Address of the home you rent
wallet.formDatesInvalid: The lease cannot end before it starts.
wallet.rentalFailed: Could not save that. Please try again.
wallet.loadFailedTitle: We could not load your rentals
wallet.loadFailedBody: Something went wrong on our side. Nothing you have recorded is lost — try again in a moment.
wallet.passportSoonSub: A portable record of rent you have paid — coming soon.
wallet.passportSoonBody: The Rent Passport is a document you hand to a future landlord, so it can only be built from rent Draazy has actually seen move. Paying rent through Draazy is coming; until then the figures above are your own record, not a credential.
